legal.draft: Draft. This text describes how the platform works; no lawyer has reviewed it.
terms: Coloc puts people looking for a room, for flatmates or for a place to share in touch, and helps flatmates organise themselves.
Coloc does not check who owns a home. A badge says exactly what was checked, and nothing more.
Coloc handles no payments. Costs and rents entered are notes between flatmates.
Legal information and generated documents are general information, not legal advice.
Listings that exclude someone for their gender, religion, origin or another protected trait are not allowed.
privacy: Account: e-mail address, chosen name, password (stored hashed).
Profile: the budget, reference place, dates and lifestyle you give. They are used for search and to compare flatmates.
Photos: location data is removed; faces and readable text are blurred before any analysis.
Assistant: your messages are analysed by models that run on the platform's server. A masked copy (phone numbers, e-mails and names replaced) is kept for 30 days to follow the conversation.
You can withdraw your agreement at any time; the conversation with the assistant is then deleted.

landing.title: Flatsharing, from the first viewing to the last rent.
landing.welcomeLead: Pick up where you left off: your search, your messages, your flatshare.
landing.lead: Find a room on the map, meet flatmates who live like you, then share rent, chores and paperwork in one place.

steps.searchText: List and map side by side. Every listing is checked before it goes live.
steps.matchText: Compatibility worked out from how you live: hours, cleaning, smoking, pets. Contact opens when you both accept.
steps.liveText: Who paid what, whose turn it is, and the flatshare's documents, ready as PDFs.

trust.checked: Every listing is checked before it is published: payment asked before a viewing, a price far too low, contact outside the site.
trust.consent: Nobody gets your details without your say-so: a contact request waits for your answer, and messages stay on the site.
trust.place: On the map the position is approximate. The exact address is never shown.
trust.money: The site keeps track of who owes what between flatmates, but never moves money.

landing.assistantText: “A furnished room in Ariana under 450 dinars.” The assistant searches, compares and answers questions about renting. What it proposes stays dashed until you save it.
